commands.text: Went back to the cave and broke the wall. The images were finished with; what was behind them was not history, it was a test, and a test implies someone expected a successor.
The Photo-audio Gu is exhausted; the wall becomes ordinary stone. Knowing where to look is what is left.

Eastern lamps, a passage, and a chamber with a golden Earth Treasury Flower in it. The inheritance hands you what the next obstacle demands. That is either generosity or design, and I have met very little generosity.
